findings: Original object recombination localizes most ARM/AArch64 native changes to the iterator object and its resulting image layout; this does not identify a hardware microarchitectural mechanism.
Original-image simulated ARM differences are solely libc memset and reverse direction between compiler/host profiles. R1467 controls exact guest launch state before attributing those counts.
AArch64 raw and MIPS detail simulated instruction/read/write totals are identical across all four variants.
